Dashboard Screen Feature Guide

2 Country Results
Check each country's score and change. Click a country card or its name in the table to
view the detailed results.
3 Summary Download
Check the active page type beside the Summary button. Click Summary to download the
country score summary.

score and item results. Compare the current and previous scores to identify
changes.
1 Pages to Fix
Click Pages to Fix to show or hide the pages that need attention.

화면 메뉴: MONITORING RESULTS > Business
Dashboard Screen Feature Guide
Click Pages to Fix and scroll down to view this screen. Review pages that need
3 attention and submit a fix request or a rejection for review.
1 All Issues/Assigned to me
Select All issues to view the full list. Select Assigned to me to show the issues assigned to
your account.
2 Request Fix or Reject
Click Request Fix to open the Jira ticket form. Click Reject to type a reason and submit
the issue for rejection review.
3 Page Details
Click the arrow button to show the page's item results and score changes. Click it again to
hide the details.
